description: This file is a shell script used for testing and verifying the consistency of documentation and help output for Git commands. It contains functions for generating documentation, checking formatting and spacing, and running assertions on command output to ensure documentation accuracy.

methods.name: help_to_synopsis
methods.description: Generates a help synopsis for a given Git builtin command, either by extracting specific sections from its help output or returning an existing cached file.

methods.name: builtin_to_adoc
methods.description: Returns the path to the AsciiDoc documentation file for a given Git builtin command.

methods.name: adoc_to_synopsis
methods.description: Converts an AsciiDoc documentation file of a Git builtin into a synopsis, extracting and formatting relevant sections.

methods.name: check_dashed_labels
methods.description: Checks that the input file does not contain labels with underscores or hyphens after a '<' character.

methods.name: align_after_nl
methods.description: Aligns lines in the input file after newlines to match the width of a command prefix, used for formatting output.
